caption: Bocca della Verità, Rome
composition: Mouth of Truth marble disk in Santa Maria in Cosmedin portico · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The great marble disk fills the left of the frame in close-up, its bearded face and dark open mouth weathered by centuries, while through the portico arches at the center the cloistered courtyard opens to the right with its patterned columns and tall brick bell tower. A few visitors cross the sunlit courtyard at 11:51. The contrast between the worn stone of the disk and the bright Romanesque architecture behind is the picture's pull.
